predeclared_replication_plan.decision_timing: After auditing the first Linux cohort and observing the first native cohort, before the requested native replication begins.
predeclared_replication_plan.reason: The first native cohort has substantial paired variability and mixed controls. The primary 100k/depth2 broad search has only3/6 faster pairs and a near-zero median paired reduction despite different separate medians. One independent identical native run will assess repeatability.
predeclared_replication_plan.reporting: Retain and report both native cohorts separately and all raw records. Summarize consistency over the12 within-run pairs without pairing different runs or mixing platforms. Do not discard observations or continue repeating until a favorable result appears.

ci_merge_recognizer_distinction.resolution: The original cohort audit independently authenticated the newer-main CI merge helper from GitHub. This repeat uses the same authenticated merge helper in all four test receipts and both build variants; all other source/support/harness hashes also match the original cohort.

reporting_recommendations: Retain native cohorts 1 and 2 separately. Secondary combined statistics are medians of all 12 within-run pair reductions per case; never pair observations from different runs and never average cohort medians.
The main search/100000/2/broad workload remains near zero in cohort 2 with three faster and three slower wall-time pairs; native large-search speedup is not reliably demonstrated.

Nested broad cached projection has positive paired wall and CPU medians with five faster wall pairs in both cohorts. Preserve its adverse observations and scope the claim to this measured component workload.
Show reversals and mixed controls. Deep broad search changes wall-time direction between runs, and flat broad projection does too; a broad macOS improvement claim is unsupported.
Small-tree broad search remains positive in each cohort. Do not convert workload-specific results into typing latency, player CPU, rendering, or memory-footprint claims.
Linux allocation-request measurements stay Linux-specific. Native cohorts did not instrument allocation requests or retained memory.
scope: Independent artifact, source, test, pair-order, command-output and numerical-summary audit. No benchmarks rerun.
